source: Prototype base checklist compiled from MSME Udyam, FSSAI, Shops & Establishment Act, and standard bank loan appraisal checklists.

registration.name: Udyam Registration
registration.why: Free national MSME registration giving official micro-enterprise recognition, priority sector status, and eligibility for interest subsidies.

registration.name: FSSAI Basic Registration / Food Licence
registration.why: Mandatory statutory food safety compliance for dairy, food stalls, tiffin services, and agri-processing.

registration.name: Gram Panchayat No Objection Certificate (NOC)
registration.why: Confirms village permission for commercial animal sheds, processing units, or retail stall operations.
registration.where: Local Gram Panchayat office / Gram Sevak

loan.name: KYC (Aadhaar Card & PAN Card)
loan.why: Primary identity, address verification, and tax identification required by RBI KYC guidelines.
loan.where: Keep physical copies & Aadhaar-linked phone for OTP authentication

loan.name: Bank Account Statements (Past 6 months)
loan.why: Demonstrates prior banking discipline, cash turnover, and average daily ledger balance to the lending branch manager.
loan.where: Home branch or mobile/internet banking PDF download

loan.name: Quotation for Machinery / Cattle / Shed Work
loan.why: Direct lender requirement for disbursing term loans directly to verified suppliers or equipment vendors.
loan.where: Authorised local equipment dealer, dairy cooperative, or registered fabricator

loan.name: Land Records / Shed Lease Agreement (7/12 Extract or 8A)
loan.why: Proves lawful occupation of the shed, grazing land, or unit location in rural areas.
loan.where: Mahabhumi portal (MahaDBT) or Talathi office

registration.name: Udyam Registration
registration.why: Official recognition as a retail micro-enterprise under revised MSME notification (NIC code 47).

registration.name: Shop & Establishment Act Registration (Gumasta)
registration.why: Regulates retail work hours, employee terms, and serves as formal trade proof for bank current account opening.
registration.where: Aaple Sarkar / Municipal council or Gram Panchayat trade register

registration.name: GST Registration (Optional / Threshold based)
registration.why: Required if turnover exceeds ₹40 Lakhs for goods, or for inter-state wholesale procurement.

loan.name: KYC Identity & Residence Proof
loan.why: Mandatory lender verification of borrower identity and residential stability.
loan.where: Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, PAN Card

loan.name: Shop Rent Agreement & Utility Bill
loan.why: Verifies physical business address, commercial tenure, and electricity load availability.
loan.where: Registered rent agreement with landlord + recent power bill

loan.name: Provisional Stock & Furniture Quotations
loan.why: Substantiates working capital and fixtures loan components under Mudra or PMEGP.
loan.where: Wholesale distributor or fixtures carpenter invoice estimate

loan.name: 6 Months Savings / Current Bank Statements
loan.why: Verifies cash velocity and past financial integrity.
loan.where: Bank branch or net banking

registration.name: Udyam Registration
registration.why: Certifies enterprise under services category for priority sector micro-lending benefits.

registration.name: Local Body Trade Licence / Gumasta
registration.why: Permissions from local authority for running a commercial service workshop or boutique.

loan.name: KYC (Aadhaar & PAN)
loan.why: Mandatory lender KYC documentation.
loan.where: Self documents

loan.name: Equipment / Machine Quotation
loan.why: Proves cost of sewing machines, cutting tables, diagnostic tools, or repair workstations.
loan.where: Authorized equipment dealer or authorized brand dealer

loan.name: Premises Proof (Ownership or Rent Agreement)
loan.why: Validates business workshop location.
loan.where: Registered rent deed or municipal tax receipt

loan.name: Skill / Experience Certificate (Optional but Recommended)
loan.why: Significantly strengthens appraisal for technical trades like tailoring, mobile repair, or IT services.
loan.where: ITI, PMKVY, vocational diploma, or self-attested portfolio

registration.name: Udyam Registration (Manufacturing)
registration.why: Primary proof of manufacturing micro-enterprise under MSME Act; unlocks PMEGP/CMEGP subsidies.

registration.name: Factory / Power NOC & Commercial Electric Connection
registration.why: Secures three-phase commercial electricity power supply for mills and heavy motor machinery.

registration.name: Pollution Control Board Consent to Establish / Operate (Green Category)
registration.why: Statutory environmental compliance for grain milling and spice pulverising units.
registration.where: State Pollution Control Board portal (MPCB / CTE-CTO)

loan.name: Detailed Project Report (DPR)
loan.why: Comprehensive technical and financial project report showing break-even, capacity utilisation, and DSCR for bankers.
loan.where: Chartered Accountant, DIC facilitation desk, or GramUdyam AI report
loan.approx_cost: ₹1,000–₹3,000 if done via external consultant; free via GramUdyam

loan.name: Machinery Quotations with GST & Performance Warranty
loan.why: Banks mandate minimum 2 competitive quotations from registered machinery manufacturers.
loan.where: Agri-machinery / pulveriser manufacturers

loan.name: Premise Title Deed / 5-Year Registered Lease Deed
loan.why: Protects bank against premature tenant eviction affecting factory machinery hypothecation.
loan.where: Sub-registrar office

loan.name: Bank Statements (12 Months)
loan.why: Assesses financial health and past credit transactions.
loan.where: Lending bank

registration.name: CSC VLE (Village Level Entrepreneur) Registration
registration.why: Authorized certification to provide government G2C and B2C digital citizen services.
registration.where: register.csc.gov.in with TEC (Telecentre Entrepreneur Course) certification

registration.name: Udyam Registration
registration.why: Recognition as a technology and IT-enabled micro-service provider.

registration.name: Police Verification Character Certificate
registration.why: Mandated for handling Aadhaar authentication, banking correspondent (BC) points, and citizen identity data.
registration.where: Local Police Station / State Police Citizen Portal

loan.name: KYC (Aadhaar & PAN)
loan.why: Lender identity proof and digital signatory validation.
loan.where: Self documents

loan.name: Hardware Invoice Quotation (Computers, Laser Printers, Biometric Scanners)
loan.why: Itemized pro-forma invoice for hardware asset financing.
loan.where: Authorized IT hardware distributor / computer store

loan.name: Shop Rent Agreement or Panchayat Allotment Letter
loan.why: Proof of accessible central village location with high public visibility.
loan.where: Gram Panchayat or private shop owner

loan.name: Educational Certificates & Computer Literacy Certificate (MS-CIT/Diploma)
loan.why: Validates operator capability to operate government portals and citizen applications.
loan.where: MKCL / recognized board certificate
